# Declarative learning sources

Profiles, activities and routes are separate exact-revision JSON records. `index.json`, `assets/learning-data.js` and `learn/` reading editions are generated delivery artifacts, not the source of mathematical authority. The archive is unchanged. Use `../docs/LEARNING_ENGINE.md` and the five format schemas under `../protocol/`.

Current bundle: 11 profiles, 24 activities, 2 routes. Teaching is draft-for-mathematical-review. No answer or passing assessment upgrades an archive verification state.
